4.12: Red Hat OpenShift 4.12 is no longer receiving updates of the NVIDIA GPU operator. The last available version is 25.3.2.
On Red Hat OpenShift 4.12, starting with the NVIDIA GPU operator v25.3.1, a user must explicitly define a driver image in ClusterPolicy. The default driver image will not work.
4.13: Red Hat OpenShift 4.13 is no longer receiving updates of the NVIDIA GPU operator. The last available version is 25.3.2.
4.16: On Red Hat OpenShift 4.16.58, the GPU operator fails to run because of a kernel version mismatch in the driver toolkit (DTK) image. See [OCPBUGS-78529](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPBUGS-78529) for details.
4.18: On Red Hat OpenShift 4.18.22 and 4.18.23, the NVIDIA GPU operator is broken. See [OCPBUGS-60663](https://issues.redhat.com/browse/OCPBUGS-60663) for details.
5.0: On Red Hat OpenShift 5, the default GPU driver image will not work. A RHEL 10-compatible driver image must be explicitly specified in ClusterPolicy.
